title: Im Heckengrund, Bensheim
description:
The spacious (106 m2, 1150 f2) and fully furnished apartment sleeps up to 4 persons. It is located in a save and quiet neighborhood, giving you quick access to Bensheim city center (5 mins) and to popular hiking /mountainbiking trails in magnificent vinyards at the same time. 
Enjoy relaxation after work on the sun terrace. You can reach Bensheim city center, the IC train station and the highway (A5, A67) in just a few minutes, giving you quick access to the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan region (Darmstadt = 20 minutes; Heidelberg/Mannheim/Frankfurt 30 minutes). Popular restaurants are located within walking distance.

The apartment is top renovated and provides 
- a spacious living room with a large real leather couch, dining table with 6 chairs, television and home office
- Two bedrooms: The first bedroom has a large king size double bed. The second 30m2/320 f2 bedroom is very spacious and provides a French bed (140cm x 200cm) and a comfortable sofa bed (140cm x 200cm), a lounger, a closet and a desk. An additional bed for toddlers and a hight-adjustable desk can be set up on request. All bedrooms have shutters to guarantee sleeping in full darkness if wanted.
- a luxury 13 m2 daylight bathroom with bath tub, shower, double vanity, ergometer, washing machine and tumbler
- a spacious kitchen with a magnificent view of the vineyards including everything you need for cooking (cookware, fridge, dishwasher, microwave, oven, coffee machine etc.) 
Fast glasfiber wifi guarantees quick internet access and free parking is available.
